title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Mix in order, pour into unbaked pastry shell.
Bake @ 425° for 15 min. reduce heat to 350° - bake for 45 min. until a knife inserted comes out clean.
see over for topping before baking.
raw_text:
Pumpkin Pie.  V.G.
2 eggs beaten
2 c pumpkin puree
3/4 c sugar
1/2 tsp. salt
2 " cinnamon
1/2 " ginger
1/4 " cloves.
1 2/3 c evaporated milk.
Mix in order, pour into unbaked pastry shell.
Bake @ 425° for 15 min. reduce heat to 350° - bake for 45
min. until a knife inserted comes out clean.
see over for topping before baking.          - over -

title: Prize Pizza Crust
directions: Soften tog. 1 pkg instant yeast - 1/4 c lukewarm H2O.
add 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp oil, 1 cup of water, 1 tsp salt, 2 3/4 c flour.
Knead tog for 10 min. Put into a pizza pan & let rise. Add favorite toppings & bake 400° - 20-25 min.

title: Soft Pretzels
directions: Mix all ingred. tog. & knead for 8-10 min. Roll out & form into pretzel shapes.
Beat 1 egg & brush over pretzels. Sprinkle c coarse salt (or spaghetti sauce).
Bake @ 425° for 10 min.
Great c cheese whiz - spread over them (can omit)
raw_text:
Soft Pretzels.
1 1/2 c lukewarm H2O.     1 tbsp sugar.
1 pkg yeast               [3?] to 4 c flour.
Mix all ingred. tog. & knead for 8-10 min. Roll out & form
into pretzel shapes. Beat 1 egg & brush over pretzels. Sprinkle c
coarse salt (or spaghetti sauce). Bake @ 425° for 10 min. Great c
cheese whiz - spread over them (can omit)

1/2 tsp salt
2 " cinnamon
1/2 " ginger
1/4 " cloves (ground)

title: Fluffy Pumpkin Pie
directions: Combine 1 c sugar c other dry ingred. in top of dbl. boiler.
Combine slightly beaten egg yolks milk & pumpkin. add grad. to 1st. mix. Stir constantly. Cook over boiling H2O about 15 min. Cool.
Beat egg whites until soft peak - add rem. sugar & beat stiff. - fold into pumpkin mix.
raw_text:
Fluffy Pumpkin Pie   (Beverly Cookbook)
1 1/4 c sugar                 1/2 tsp. ginger
3 rounded tbsp cornstarch     1/2 " salt
1 tsp. cinnamon               3 eggs separated
3 tbsp. flour                 2 c milk
1/2 tsp. nutmeg               2 c pumpkin
Combine 1 c sugar c other dry ingred. in top of dbl. boiler.
Combine slightly beaten egg yolks milk & pumpkin.
add grad. to 1st. mix. Stir constantly. Cook over
boiling H2O about 15 min. Cool. Beat egg whites until
soft peak - add rem. sugar & beat stiff. - fold into Pumpkin Mix.

raw_text:
Ukrainian Pastry Khrustyky (Cara[?]).
2 eggs.                    2 tbsp. rum or brandy.
3 egg yolks                1 c plus 2 tbsp. flour.
2 tbsp. sugar              confectioners sugar.
1 tbsp. rich cream         1/2 tsp. salt.
Beat eggs tog. until very light. Beat in sugar, cream,
salt & rum or brandy. Sift in flour. This dough should
be soft. Cover & let rest for 10 min. Roll very thin. 1/8"
or thinner. Use a sm. amt of dough @ a time & keep rest
covered - as it dries quickly. Cut the rolled dough into long

title: Bavarian Appletort Cheese Cake
Bavarian Appletort Cheese Cake
directions: Cream margarine, sugar & vanilla. Blend in flour. Spread dough on the bottom & sides of 9" spring form pan.
Combine softened cream cheese & sugar & mix well. Add egg & vanilla & mix with mixer. Then pour over the pastry in pan.
Combine sugar & cinnamon. Toss apples in sugar mixture. Spoon apples over cream cheese layer & sprinkle on nuts.
Bake @ 450° - 10 minutes then reduce heat to 375° & bake another 30 min.
Cool before removing from pan. Refrigerate.

title: Impossible Bacon Quiche
ingredients: 1 c grated swiss or cheddar cheese
directions: Lightly grease 10" pie plate. Sprinkle bacon, onion & cheese on plate.
Beat milk, eggs, biscuit mix & seasoning tog. until smooth, approx 1 min. Pour into pie plate.
Bake @ 400° - for 35 min. or until golden & knife inserted comes clean. Let stand 5 min. Garnish if desired. serve 4-6
notes: Top right corner, partly cut off: '(Marg[?] ... ) Friends' [?]
raw_text:
Impossible Bacon Quiche   ([Marg?] [?]) Friends[?]
12 slices bacon, cooked & crumbled.
1/4 c chopped onion
1 c grated swiss or cheddar cheese.
2 c milk
1 c biscuit mix.
4 eggs
1/4 tsp. salt.
1/8 " pepper.
bacon & tomatoes for garnish
Lightly grease 10" pie plate. sprinkle bacon, onion
& cheese on plate. Beat milk, eggs, biscuit mix
& seasoning tog. until smooth, approx 1 min.
Pour into pie plate. Bake @ 400° - for 35 min. or
until golden & knife inserted comes clean. Let
stand 5 min. Garnish if desired. serve 4-6
